clause: Equivalence of unit ground fidelity, zero deviation, and the pure ground state for normal states
evidence_or_owed: The proposition ends with zero weight outside the ground exactly for the ground projection, and the sentence after its proof lists the three equivalent conditions. Here the equivalence follows from the upper bound on the trace distance.

clause: Ground-fixing CPTP channel
evidence_or_owed: Stated for any family of channels on the appearance space. A single channel is the case of a family with one member. The proposition that follows shows that a channel fixing the ground cannot increase the weight outside it for any state, and the text adds that every outcome of an instrument with such a channel leaves the ground on the ground.

clause: Ground fidelity and deviation under every unitary preserving the ground ray
evidence_or_owed: The weight outside the ground is invariant under every unitary that fixes the ground projection, for every state. The text draws the consequence that such an evolution is ground-attractive only on the basin consisting of the ground, and that a unitary can move a chosen vector to the ground only by moving the ground.

clause: Ground fixed and deviation tending to zero throughout a specified basin
draft_quote: It is \emph{ground-attractive} on a set $\mathsf B$ of states if
evidence_or_owed: Defined as in the source by both conditions: the family fixes the ground, and the weight outside it tends to zero on a specified set of states, the basin. The text notes that the second condition is trace-norm convergence. Canonical deconditioning is the instance whose basin is every state.

clause: Strong continuity on the trace class
evidence_or_owed: Part (a) bounds the trace norm of the change of any trace-class operator by 4(1-exp(-γt)) times its norm. This is continuity in the operator norm on the trace class, which implies the strong continuity of the source.

clause: (i) Ground projection fixed
evidence_or_owed: Part (c) states that the ground projection is fixed.

clause: (ii) Exact decay of ground deviation
evidence_or_owed: Part (d), for every state, by tracing the block formula against the complement of the ground.

clause: (iii) Unique fixed normal state at every positive time
evidence_or_owed: Part (c): at a positive time the fixed trace-class operators are the multiples of the ground projection, so it is the only fixed state.

clause: (iv) Trace-norm estimate with constant 2
evidence_or_owed: Part (e), from the bound for a pure target proved in the preceding proposition. The text adds a lower bound, which is attained, and a sharper upper bound that is an equality for pure inputs. It follows that the source's bound is strict at positive times and that its constant 2 is optimal. A fixed pure input shows that the rate γ/2 is optimal.

clause: Trace-class generator at zero
evidence_or_owed: Part (b) gives the generator as a bounded operator on the trace class, with the relaxation as its exponential. The form with one jump operator for each direction orthogonal to the ground is displayed.

clause: Lyapunov law and finite-time ground recovery
evidence_or_owed: The paragraph after the jump form gives the differential law, strict decrease while the weight is positive, and that the ground is reached at a finite time only from the ground.

clause: Environmental realization of irreversible reduced evolution
evidence_or_owed: An isometry into the appearance space tensored with an environment gives each relaxation step as a reduced unitary evolution. The text says that this does not identify an environment in an observer, and that one unitary group for all times needs an infinite-dimensional larger space, which is not constructed.

clause: Momentary ground covariance and contraction factors
evidence_or_owed: Both conditions are displayed, with the remark that the first concerns the channels and the second the particular sequence of states. Carrying the ground is shown to be the same as contraction of every state with the factor one.

clause: Exact realization persists under momentary ground covariance
evidence_or_owed: Part (a).

clause: Variable contraction product and asymptotic stabilization
evidence_or_owed: Part (b): the product bound, the trace-norm bound in each space, and convergence when the products tend to zero. The text notes that the bound does not use the first condition. Part (c) states that the first condition already gives the factors one. Products tending to zero are shown to be sufficient and, by an example with two resets, not necessary for bounds that hold for every state.

clause: Exact event and asymptotic stabilization
draft_quote: We say that the sequence \emph{is at the ground} at moment $n$ when
evidence_or_owed: Both notions are defined and distinguished by the deconditioning steps, under which a sequence off the ground is never at the ground and stabilizes when the rates times durations have a divergent sum. The cognitive names are given in one sentence.

clause: Projective actualization and its exact domain
evidence_or_owed: The returned state is defined for density operators. For a pure state it is the ray of V*φ, defined exactly when φ is not in the orthogonal complement of D.

clause: Trace of the return operation, trace nonincrease and normalized successful branch
evidence_or_owed: The compression has trace equal to the weight in D, the map is completely positive and does not increase the trace, and the normalized state is displayed with its pairing. The text separates the probability, which any measurement with this effect gives, from the state afterwards, which requires an instrument with this operation, and says when a later measurement distinguishes two instruments.

clause: Complementary probability of physical presentation
evidence_or_owed: Displayed for every appearance state when the target lies in D.

clause: Restricted conditional return gives the vacuum at positive time
evidence_or_owed: The restricted return of the relaxed state is the physical reference projection times a coefficient that is positive at every positive time.

clause: Global conditional return after deconditioning
evidence_or_owed: For every initial appearance state the normalized return converges in trace norm to the partner of the ground, with an explicit bound. The partner is the vacuum exactly under strong polar compatibility, and the two returns are contrasted on the unequal-cell path.
